item.title: THE BATMAN Part II May Focus More On Gilda Dent Than Harvey Dent; Could We See A Female Two-Face?
item.description: With Scarlett Johansson and Sebastian Stan set to star opposite Robert Pattinson in The Batman Part II, new details have emerged about what to expect from Gilda and Harvey Dent.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumor Once Again Makes A Case For Sadie Sink Playing The MCU's Jean Grey
item.description: The latest Spider-Man: Brand New Day rumour once again points to Stranger Things star Sadie Sink making her MCU debut as the all-new, all-different Jean Grey.

item.title: AGATHA ALL ALONG Star Kathryn Hahn Will Play The Villainous Mother Gothel In Disney's Live-Action TANGLED
item.description: It may have been Mother Gothel all along for Kathryn Hahn, as the actress has been cast in Disney's live-action Tangled remake, a role Disney fans have long campaigned for her to take on.

item.title: RUMOR: BLADE Reboot Dead At Marvel Studios; Marhershala Ali Will Debut As The Daywalker In MIDNIGHT SONS
item.description: It seems Marvel Studios may have finally decided to pull the plug on the long-awaited Blade reboot, but we're hearing that Marhershala Ali will still get to play the character in Midnight Sons...

item.title: RUMOR: New Details On Doctor Doom's "Harbingers Of Doom" In AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Revealed - SPOILERS
item.description: The latest Avengers: Doomsday rumour to do the rounds online claims to shed new light on Doctor Doom and the allies he'll have by his side when facing the Avengers, X-Men, and Fantastic Four.

item.title: LEE CRONIN'S THE MUMMY Leak Reveals "Vile" Scene, First Plot Details; James Wan Walked Out Of Test Screening
item.description: Following recent test screening—which reportedly did not go well—we have some leaked story details for Lee Cronin's The Mummy (The Resurrected?), with one scene described as "vile."

item.title: THE LORD OF THE RINGS: New Details About THE HUNT FOR GOLLUM's Search For An Actor To Play Younger Aragorn
item.description: With cameras set to roll on The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum this summer, it sounds like Andy Serkis is gearing up to cast Viggo Mortensen's replacement as Aragorn.

item.title: WONDER MAN TV Spot Reveals First Official Look At Simon Williams In His Comic-Accurate Superhero Suit
item.description: The latest TV spot for Marvel Television's Wonder Man reveals a first look at Yahya Abdul-Mateen II's Simon Williams suited up in his comic-accurate superhero costume.

item.title: WOLVERINE: 8 Stories Marvel Studios Should Consider Telling In The Post-AVENGERS: SECRET WARS MCU
item.description: With Hugh Jackman expected to continue playing the MCU's Wolverine after Avengers: Secret Wars, we're taking a closer look at the stories that could be told featuring the clawed mutant.

item.title: Bautista & Momoa Unleash Brotherly Chaos! First Trailer For THE WRECKING CREW Delivers LETHAL WEAPON Vibes
item.description: David Bautista and Jason Momoa team up as a pair of recently reunited estranged brothers in the upcoming action-comedy The Wrecking Crew.
